prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Production asset: high-quality hand-painted motorcycle-rider action sprite atlas.
Image1 is the EDIT TARGET: an approved4-column by4-row sprite template, sixteen complete sprites. Image2 is an identity/material reference ONLY. Image3 is the reviewed ACTION POSE/QUALITY guide from a different angle group: match its mild/full articulation and invariant physical proportions, but NEVER copy its yaw angles; Image1 alone fixes all sixteen specific views.
Edit the rider pose in every cell of Image1 for COLLISION IMPACT BRACE. Keep exactly sixteen sprites in exactly the same4x4 layout. Upper two rows are eight consecutive directions in the MILD/MIDPOINT stage; lower two rows repeat those EXACT SAME eight directions in the FULL stage. Read row-major within each half. Preserve EACH cell specific yaw angle from Image1: only REAR through REAR-RIGHT; backs and tail lights remain visible in all eight cells, never the front/chest, eight tiny yaw increments covering about40degrees, NOT a generic full turnaround. Corresponding upper/lower cells have identical views and identical motorcycles.
The rider briefly compresses FORWARD into an IMPACT BRACE: hips stay seated on the SAME saddle, knees grip the tank, shoulders hunch, elbows fold more sharply and helmet lowers toward the handlebar area. Mild stage: gentle start of compression. Full stage: clear compact protective crouch, forward and down a little more than the acceleration pose, while both hands stay on their same grips and both boots stay on the same pegs. No ejection, crash damage, extra limbs, wheel motion or deformation of the motorcycle.
Keep the approved slim rider identity, SAME unchanged round helmet diameter, SAME torso and limb dimensions, brown padded leather suit, bronze helmet with black visor, olive-bronze dual-sport motorcycle, rack, exhaust and chain on their true physical sides. Preserve MOTORCYCLE geometry exactly: wheel centres, tire diameter, wheelbase, chassis, saddle, lights, mirrors and handlebars stay the same. No yaw/perspective change, steering, deformation or wheel motion. Only physically plausible rider articulation changes. Preserve the fine painted texture and warm bronze/olive/brown palette, with crisp fine detail. Fixed orthographic camera, lighting and model scale. Critical: helmet and wheels never grow or shrink between cells or action stages.
Output high-resolution square PNG, ideally2048x2048, exactly4 columns by4 rows, one complete cutout per cell. Use cell area generously like Image1 while leaving clear empty gutters and safe edges. TRUE transparent background, clean antialiased edges, no matte, haze, halos, colored fringe, detached specks, shadows, scenery, text or grid lines. Do not copy the same upright pose sixteen times: upper two rows show the mild action and lower two rows its visibly stronger full action. Never mirror physical sides; natural occlusion is correct.
